test_title: PYST 20 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain coded language 'PRAM' is coded as 'KLVG' and 'DENY' is coded as 'YYIS'. How will 'HATS' be coded in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba44b4c5374f7bd10735c00e9bbde46f5a0070d70756ec8178c697e030d7d9ce.png] 

PRAM → KLVG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65c2f44f5ec1e3b5e62095ae907785ec54fc52e6c07e811df1d0333eb0f5deed.png] 

DENY → YYIS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35ecbbea1719414c5962dddc44019e26200288eb1ed1fafc673bb7363ac79b14.png] 

Now apply the same to **HATS**:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dbf76ef6e58d7bd9e5156566cea651e776867de01761617e28cba44dfa3668a.png] 

So, the code becomes **CUOM**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
